lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  funext x
  by_contra hx
  have hc : Continuous (fun y => ⟪f y, f x⟫_ℝ) :=
    Continuous.inner' _ _ hf continuous_const
  have hp : 0 < ⟪f x, f x⟫_ℝ :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne real_inner_self_nonneg' (Ne.symm (mt inner_self_eq_zero'.mp hx))
  obtain ⟨r, hr, h⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp
    (hc.continuousAt.eventually_const_lt hp)
  letI : HasContDiffBump Y := hasContDiffBump_of_innerProductSpace Y
  let φ : ContDiffBump x := ⟨r / 2, r, half_pos hr, half_lt_self hr⟩
  have hn : ∀ y, 0 ≤ φ y * ⟪f y, f x⟫_ℝ := by
    intro y
    by_cases hy : φ y = 0
    · rw [hy, zero_mul]
    · exact mul_nonneg φ.nonneg (h ((φ.support_eq ▸ hy) : y ∈ Metric.ball x r)).le
  have hi := (φ.continuous.mul hc).integral_pos_of_hasCompactSupport_nonneg_nonzero
    (μ := μ) φ.hasCompactSupport.mul_right hn
    (mul_pos (φ.pos_of_mem_ball (Metric.mem_ball_self hr)) hp).ne'
  have hz := hg (fun y => φ y • f x)
    (IsTestFunction.smul_right ⟨φ.contDiff, φ.hasCompactSupport⟩ contDiff_const)
  simp only [inner_smul_right'] at hz
  exact hi.ne' hz
